treatment_summary: The plan aligns with NICE CG126/NG185 for secondary prevention of coronary artery disease: continue aspirin, switch to high‑intensity atorvastatin 80 mg, maintain ACE‑I/HCTZ, up‑titrate metoprolol to 50 mg BID to achieve target HR, and discontinue duplicate simvastatin. NSAIDs, thiazolidinediones, verapamil with beta‑blocker, and ACE‑I + ARB are avoided. Baseline labs (eGFR, potassium, LFTs) and clinical parameters (HR, BP) are required before implementation, with monitoring as per NICE recommendations.
